description: Audit social content-marketing note content for policy compliance and shadowban / traffic-throttling risk. Scans for banned words, superlative / absolute-claim (极限词) violations, and sensitive content, flags the risks, and returns actionable, compliant rewrite suggestions to avoid throttling, takedown, or account penalties. Use when the user wants to check a social note before posting, do 违禁词检测 / 合规审核 / 笔记预审, review social copy for compliance, or assess shadowban / 限流 risk. Trigger keywords: social note, content marketing, compliance, audit, 审核, 违禁词, 极限词, 限流, shadowban, moderation. Requires an API key from wsdsocial.com.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
